a.lede: The FBI and CISA warn that hackers are actively targeting industrial refrigeration and cold-chain monitoring systems worldwide, potentially causing food spoilage, equipment damage, and fire hazards. [...]
a.title: FBI, CISA warn of cyberattacks targeting refrigeration systems

b.lede: France has linked October cyberattacks that disrupted refrigeration systems at more than 700 supermarkets and other retail locations to Iranian state-backed hackers, saying the attacks caused food losses and sparked at least 15 fires. [...]
b.title: France blames Iranian hackers for supermarket attacks that sparked fires
